brand_vibe: Apple meets Linear and Vercel. Calm, premium, purposeful, and structural. Communicates 'builds real systems' through extreme precision, restraint, and intentional typography.

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit (Do not use Inter). Use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and font-medium to font-semibold for a mechanical, high-precision feel.
typography.body: Geist Sans, IBM Plex Sans, or Inter (for high legibility technical reading).
typography.monospace: Geist Mono or JetBrains Mono (for overlines, labels, and metrics).

scale.Overline: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500

colors.background: #010102 (Linear-style deep void black) or #0A0A0A (Obsidian). Do not use pitch #000000 without texture.
colors.accent: Subtle desaturated Lavender-Blue (#5e6ad2) or stark pure White for hover states and focus rings. Avoid excessive gradients.
colors.borders: border-white/5 or border-zinc-800 for hairline precision.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Optical Clarity' Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px border-white/10) exclusively for the sticky navigation. Use solid matte levels for content cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: Hairline precision (1px solid border-white/5). Never rely heavily on drop shadows in dark mode; rely on border contrast.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the hero section background to kill digital flatness.

layout_and_grids.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, or p-16 for containers. Leave vast negative space to frame content.
layout_and_grids.bento_grid: Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical bento grid for the Expertise section. Mix col-span-4 and col-span-8 to create visual tension.
layout_and_grids.alignment: Strict left-alignment for text block precision. Use standard CSS grid and flexbox to enforce geometric rigidity.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MUST use 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling. It adds weight and premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Subtle, functional. Use Framer Motion for scroll-reveals (staggered fade-up, opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0).
motion_and_interactions.hover: Cards should have a crisp -translate-y-1 lift with a border color shift (e.g., border-white/20).
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line kinetic reveal on load. Words or lines translate Y from below a hidden overflow mask.

components.navigation: Sticky top, glassmorphism, left-aligned logo/name, right-aligned links. Must have 'data-testid'.
components.buttons: Minimalist pill or sharp rectangles. Primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-500 text-white.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border. No excessive drop-shadows.

hero.layout: Min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-center. Large masked text reveal. One signature abstract 3D or parallax graphic floating subtly on the right or center.
hero.content: 'Daler Rahimov', 'Founder, AI Engineer, Data Architect, Product Builder.'

about.visuals: Large, faint numbers behind or beside crisp typography answering 'Why I build software'.

expertise.content: Cards: AI Engineering, Data Architecture, Enterprise AI, Product Development.
expertise.details: Explain what and why. Use tracing beam borders or crisp hover states.

featured_projects.layout: Editorial case studies. Vertical stack with massive gaps (gap-32).
featured_projects.structure: Each project includes Problem, Solution, Architecture, Tech, Outcome, Lessons.
featured_projects.visuals: Use provided abstract images as elegant fallbacks for architecture diagrams.

experience.content: Graduate Assistant/Enterprise AI, Data Architect UNK Libraries, IFC Data Analytics.

metrics_strip.layout: react-fast-marquee. Slow, smooth drift. border-y border-white/10.
metrics_strip.content: 250+ ChatGPT Enterprise users • 10+ classrooms • 2,484 library observations • production deployment • three languages.

footer.layout: Massive padding (py-32). Huge Let's Talk CTA.
footer.links: Email, LinkedIn, GitHub. Resume placeholder download button.

media.rules: Never use placeholders. Use these abstract minimal images for project architectures and hero accents.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Zinc-400 on Black meets guidelines. Always provide hover contrast changes.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. E.g., data-testid='nav-about-link', data-testid='resume-download-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required libraries: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis, react-fast-marquee, etc.
Implement a deep dark theme. Do NOT use Inter for headings—use Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or Geist Sans with tight tracking.
Use framer-motion for a line-by-line masked text reveal in the hero.
Ensure lenis is wrapped globally for smooth scrolling.
Build the 4 expertise cards strictly in a 4-item bento grid layout (Mode A).
Structure the projects as editorial case studies with wide padding and use the provided abstract Unsplash images as fallbacks for architecture diagrams.
Add react-fast-marquee for the factual metrics strip.
DO NOT create generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical alignments.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds over scrollable content. Use a glassmorphism backdrop-blur for the nav.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons and links.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make it crisp, structural, and disciplined.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. p-8, p-12.
Create depth through 1px border highlights, NOT heavy muddy shadows.
Do not center align the app container. Respect optical left-alignment.
Never use AI emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover and focus states.
Do not use transparent overlays without blur.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for robust testing.
